_meta.source: NBA Cup (In-Season Tournament) championship game, one row per edition
_meta.note: The championship game does NOT count toward the regular season. Ashwin ruled 2026-09-19 that it counts as a POSTSEASON game for standings tracking, so the season table's playoff column includes it. `year` is the season's END year, matching public/data/nba/elo/seasons/<year>.json. `west`/`east` are the conference champions as the Elo data names them, and `score` is west-first.
